info.name: Get historical best active orders in a collection

params.name: type
params.description: Type of orders. Only the orders of this type will be searched

params.name: platform
params.description: Platform where the order was created

params.name: collectionId
params.description: Collection in which to look for best orders

params.name: time
params.description: Point in time at which to return best orders

params.name: topK
params.description: How many best orders to return. If not specified, some default amount is returned

items.docs: Return K best active orders in a collection as they were at the specified point in time.  For Sell orders, the best are the cheapest ones; and for Buy orders, the best are the most expensive ones.  The orders are sorted in the order of goodness, with best order always the first.

info.name: Get historical active orders in a collection closest in price to the specified order at the time

params.name: orderId
params.description: The reference order used to find orders with prices closest to its price. Must belong to the specified collection

params.name: time
params.description: Point in time at which to return closest orders

params.name: topK
params.description: How many closest orders to return. If not specified, some default amount is returned

items.docs: Return K orders in a collection that were active at the specified point in time, which are the closest in price to the specified order.  Ties are broken first by price: for Sell orders, the best are the cheapest ones; and for Buy orders, the best are the most expensive ones.  Then ties are broken by creation date, the earlier, the better.  The specified order is not included in the returned K results.

info.name: Get historical active orders in a collection closest to the specified price

params.name: type
params.description: Type of orders. Only the orders of this type will be searched

params.name: platform
params.description: Platform where the order was created

params.name: collectionId
params.description: Collection in which to look for closest orders

params.name: time
params.description: Point in time at which to return closest orders

params.name: topK
params.description: How many closest orders to return. If not specified, some default amount is returned

params.name: priceUsd
params.description: The reference price used to find closest orders, in USD

items.docs: Return K closest orders in a collection that were active at the specified point in time.  Ties are broken first by price: for Sell orders, the best are the cheapest ones; and for Buy orders, the best are the most expensive ones.  Then ties are broken by creation date, the earlier, the better.
